scope: One fixed-orientation rectangular rigid plane; prescribed normal motion; explicit planar exposed source faces; fixed topology; independent fixed tissue supports; small-strain Q1 elastic/one-Maxwell material. No live actions, friction, cutting, CUSA, fitting or physiological validation.

fixtures.support: All three components on the explicitly selected bottom source faces, independent of blade contact
fixtures.surface: Explicit top source faces, in-image void neighbor; rectangular reference footprint clipped exactly to faces
fixtures.denseOracle: Independent dense Q1 assembly and primal constrained solve on the coarsest partial fixture; compare displacement and aggregate contact force, never nonunique point pressure

failurePolicy: Retain every scored failure and refused configuration. No tolerance/fixture changes in this version. Underintegrated order1 is diagnostic and may refuse continuous penetration. Require all order2 admitted steps to pass equilibrium, positivity, complementarity, full clipped-face corner gap and discrete energy checks. Refuse unsupported bodies even while touching. Sharp-edge peak stress is not a convergence metric.

predecessor.reason: Method clarification before any production-kernel scoring; fixtures, tolerances and resource limits unchanged.

discretization.gap: g = C u - b >= 0 mm; inward normal; positive prescribed offset indents; lambda >= 0 N; K u - C^T lambda = history load
discretization.surface: Exact reference-rectangle clipping of explicitly selected aligned planar source Q1 faces; Gauss rows plus all four clipped-rectangle vertex inequalities per face. Bilinear Q1 gap extrema occur at these vertices, bounding the complete clipped reference patch.
discretization.forces: All multipliers are integrated normal forces in N, including zero-integration-weight corner guards. No point-pressure uniqueness or peak-stress convergence claim.
discretization.area: Reference Gauss area where gap <= declared tolerance; corner guards have zero area weight. Surface order sweep tests integration/area and algebraic consistency over the same vertex-bounded feasible set, not independent force accuracy.
discretization.footprint: Linearized fixed REFERENCE footprint. Projected deformed/loaded footprint migration is reported, not treated as qualified current-configuration edge geometry. No tangential blade motion or friction.
discretization.enforcement: Positive-semidefinite dual bound QP with rank-revealing polish and full primal/dual/stationarity/complementarity/energy residual checks; no penalty spring.
